query: How do I upload my map
chat_response:
To upload your map file in this part of the form:

1. Make sure your map is already saved on your device as a file (for example, a PDF, image, or document).
2. Click the **Add files** button to open your device’s file picker.
3. In the file picker, select your map file (you can choose more than one if needed), then confirm so it appears in the upload queue.
4. In the queue, you’ll see a row with the filename, status, size, and a **Description** box. If you wish, type a brief description of the map in that per-file Description field.
5. When your file is listed in the queue, click the **Start upload** button to upload it.

If no files are queued, the area will show “Drag files here” with total status 0% and size 0 b, and **Start upload** may be disabled.

Always select files, enter descriptions, and start uploads directly in this form yourself. Do not share personal information, signatures, file contents, addresses, phone numbers, emails, or client details with AIFA-AI Form Assist.

query: i have a Drawing to Scale document to upload
chat_response:
You can upload your “Drawing to Scale” on the Step 5 document upload page as a supporting file for your Water Licence Application. This drawing is mandatory and must meet the Water Application Drawing Standards.

Your Drawing to Scale must:

- Use a clear, consistent scale (for example, 1 cm = 50 m or 1:5000).
- Show a north arrow.
- Include coordinates for the centre of the drawing (e.g., latitude/longitude or UTM).

It should clearly show:

- The water source location and its name/type (stream, well, etc.), including direction of flow.
- Property boundaries where water will be used.
- All land parcels (private and Crown) that will be crossed, flooded, or used for access.
- Any reservoir locations and whether they are natural or man-made.
- The actual place(s) of use (house, barn, pasture, irrigation fields, etc.).
- Any areas that will be flooded.
- The intake/diversion structure or well location.
- Irrigation areas, if applicable.
- All existing and proposed works (pipelines, pumps, ponds, reservoirs, irrigation systems).

Accepted formats include:

- Digital maps (PDF or spatial files) such as those created with iMapBC, Google Earth (KML/KMZ), or other GIS formats (shapefiles, GeoJSON).
- Hand-drawn sketches, as long as they are clear and include scale, north arrow, and coordinates.
- Existing base maps such as Regional District Composite Maps, Surveyor’s Certificates, or Legal Survey Plans.

When uploading on Step 5:

- Make sure the file is not a ZIP file.
- Ensure the file size is no larger than 50MB.
- Upload the drawing as its own file using the file upload button on the Step 5 page.

Applications may be returned if the drawing does not meet the required standards. For full details and examples, you can review the Water Application Drawing Standards (2016) here: [Water Application Drawing Standards (2016)](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/environment/air-land-water/water/water-licensing-and-rights/new_drawing_standards_final_2016.pdf).

query: the authorization be issued to a Company/Organization/Government
chat_response:
AIFA-AI Form Assist confirms that for your application, the authorization can be issued directly to a company, organization, or government body rather than to an individual.

On your Step 7 screen, in the field titled “If approved, will the authorization be issued to an Individual or Company/Organization/Government?”, you should select **“Company/Organization/Government”**. This tells the system that the water licence authorization will be in the name of a corporate, organizational, or governmental entity.

Authorizations under the Water Sustainability Act are often issued to an individual, but there are important exceptions where entities such as municipalities, regional districts, improvement districts, development districts, water users’ communities, specific organizations (e.g., Greater Vancouver Water District, BC Hydro and Power Authority), and the Governments of British Columbia or Canada (or their commissions/boards/authorities) can hold authorizations. An authorized agent may also submit the application on behalf of these entities, with a Letter of Agency where required.

For any case‑specific clarification about whether your particular authorization type should be issued to a company/organization/government or an individual, you can contact FrontCounter BC through their [FrontCounter BC website](http://www.frontcounterbc.gov.bc.ca/).

Please do not share any personal information (such as names, addresses, phone numbers, emails, client numbers, or other personal details) with AIFA-AI Form Assist here. Enter all required information directly into the form fields on your application screen.
